goal: Project unique verified Blizzard item media into the immutable Gear Release owner, then build a dormant Gear Release, Catalog, Exact Registry and Season Manifest dependency vector whose public slot payloads contain complete canonical media without changing the active pointer or triggering any source sync.
userValue: Players can browse every returned legal equipment candidate in the real WeChat equipment simulator without blank images, frontend fallbacks or media facts detached from the immutable Catalog provenance.
nonGoals: Do not claim the current-season PVE universe is complete; that requires the separately governed official source snapshot and omission ledger.
Do not change the active Season Manifest pointer, production backend, source ingestion, staging rows, legality rules, Resolver semantics or SimC policy.
Do not download official source data, install dependencies, trigger Blizzard or Raider.IO sync, or start the stopped stat/backfill workers.
Do not patch Taro or the public read model with a runtime media fallback.

mustChange: The Gear Release staging snapshot projects an icon only from one conflict-free cache.websim_asset_registry row whose source is blizzard and status is verified.
A new dormant Gear Release carries those projected facts; matching dormant Catalog, Exact Registry and candidate Manifest revisions bind the new release identity.
The candidate API and exhaustive Catalog matrix reject every selectable item whose immutable ItemDefinition media remains missing.
mustNotChange: The active Manifest pointer and generation 35 remain byte-for-byte and numerically unchanged.
Existing staging media wins; ambiguous registry URLs remain missing and fail closed.
Production runtime, sync/backfill/collector state, legality authority, Resolver and SimC behavior remain unchanged.
No frontend fallback, external download, source sync or destructive database operation is introduced.
riskUnknown: The full staging snapshot contains 52102 variants and 32869 sources and may require bounded memory/time even though the underlying relations are only about 225 MB.
A new Gear Release invalidates the old Community, Catalog and Exact dependency identities; every downstream dormant revision must be rebuilt against exactly one vector.
Two staging items without unique verified registry evidence must remain explicitly missing and cannot be silently presented as complete.
evidenceRequired: RED/GREEN unit tests proving existing media wins, one verified Blizzard URL is projected and conflicting URLs fail closed.
Read-only live projection evidence for item IDs 239653, 245769, 245770 and 250052, plus explicit accounting for all other missing-media rows.
Resource-bounded dormant Gear Release, Community, Catalog, Exact Registry and Manifest builds with deterministic identities, unchanged active pointer and timer/backflow checks.
A 40-specialization by legal-slot by returned-item automated API ledger with zero missing media on selectable candidates, followed later by the final Goal's same-candidate complete WeChat matrix.

ownership.factOwner: cache.websim_asset_registry owns verified upstream media evidence; GearReleaseStore owns conflict-free projection into immutable Gear Release payloads; Catalog and Exact builders own revision-bound downstream persistence; Taro consumes only returned canonical media.

engineeringHealth.reason: The fix crosses immutable data ownership and production PostgreSQL while full staging projection is memory-heavy. One-at-a-time cgroup-bounded execution, active-pointer fencing, no sync and exact downstream identity checks are mandatory.

acceptanceEvidence: All four items with one unique verified Blizzard registry URL receive canonical iconUrl and verified gameAsset facts in the new immutable Gear Release and Catalog.
An existing staging icon is never overwritten and an ambiguous or absent source remains missing with an explicit blocker.
Every selectable candidate returned across all 40 specializations and legal slots has immutable Catalog media; no UI/runtime fallback is used.
The new Gear Release, Community Release, Catalog, Exact Registry and candidate Manifest form one consistent dormant dependency vector.
The active Manifest remains generation 35 and production services remain available; async sync, collectors, stat worker and observed backfill remain off during the candidate operation.
This slice is not promoted as current-season PVE universe completeness or final WeChat acceptance.

decisionLog.decision: The user authorized necessary project and known-cloud operations while requiring strict server resource protection, upstream root-cause repair and Harness control.
The user requires final real WeChat validation across multiple classes, all specializations and cross-equipment combinations; this dormant backend slice remains only one prerequisite.

Live evidence traced blank candidate images from verified Blizzard asset registry rows that were not materialized into staging snapshots, Gear Release payloads or Catalog ItemDefinitions; the repair therefore belongs at GearReleaseStore rather than Taro.
